answer: A farm's real prize is votes, and votes cast by one mind move together. Over many epochs the network records how every pair of graders scored the same answers. Two identities that agree far more often than independent judges would end up sharing one vote's weight, like boats tied to one mooring rising on the same tide. To keep its weight, a farm must make its fakes genuinely disagree, which spends the very control it bought. Honest graders differ naturally, the way each crystal bends violet light at its own angle.
